home.entriesTitle: What would you like to do?
home.spacesIntro: Six exceptional venues for seminars, receptions, film shoots and weddings, for up to 1,500 guests.

agenda.title: Events & tickets
agenda.intro: Guided tours, special days and public events: book your tickets online.
agenda.groupsText: From 10 people, visits are booked on request with a personalised quote.
agenda.ticketsText: Online ticketing is provided by the estate's ticketing platform (to be confirmed). Payment is secure; tickets are sent by e-mail.
